title: ILD2 Lets Play SMP
description: This modpack was inspired by my previous modpack, and by Simply Optimized. It has every mod from Simply Optimized to help with optimization on fps-challenged sessions, as well as some other fun ones!
body:
**_NOTE: Due to copyright issues, I can not add any data/resource packs from VanillaTweaks.net. This text will be removed if/when this issue is resolved, along with a new version with the files. Please refer to our Discord server with any questions and for links to pages to download the packs._**

Welcome to our modpack! Please note that this IS NOT a mod pack that will be updated frequently, this is just something we do in our free time. I will try my best to reply to any questions/suggestions about this mod pack on our Discord server. 
*****
**_After a long and challenging day, you decide to fire up your purchased digital copy of Fabric 1.21 for Minecraft Java using the fantastic Modrinth launcher. You eagerly anticipate the familiar screen that appears when creating a new world. As you enter this new world, it feels like stepping into the unknown after what seemed like an eternity of waiting for it to load. The excitement rushes through you as you begin exploring the vibrant world, with new terrain materializing before your eyes. Playing this pack seems to make all your worries disappear, and you can't wait to invite your friends to join you. Together, armed with the renowned Essential mod and others, you dive into the shared experience of building and crafting. Remember, the essence of the game lies in discovering new realms, going on adventures, and most importantly, enjoying every moment of fun!_**

During the writing process of the above story, Grammarly generated responses to the following AI prompts:

Prompts created by Grammarly
- "Make it more detailed"
- "Sound fluent"
